title: rsa_key_import shared across rsa-2048 and rsa-4096 — no size enforcement
description: wolfssl_rsa_2048_ops and wolfssl_rsa_4096_ops both use wolfssl_rsa_key_import. That function sets ctx->key_size_bytes from the actual decoded key (wc_RsaEncryptSize). So importing a 2048-bit key via the rsa-4096 handle succeeds: the handle is named rsa-4096 but produces 256-byte signatures, not 512-byte. FIPS 140-3 requires the algorithm boundary to be enforced. Fix: add a check in key_import that key_size_bytes equals the expected size for the algorithm. The expected size must be passed as a parameter (similar to how EC uses scalar_len/pubkey_len).
